name: Yuexiu Services Group Ltd.
summary: Yuexiu Services Group Limited, founded in 1992, is an investment holding company providing property management in mainland China and Hong Kong, formerly named Yuexiu Property Management Holding Limited. It reports non-commercial property management with value-added services, and commercial property management with operational services. Offerings include cleaning, security, gardening and maintenance, sales office and pre-delivery support for developers, carpark services, advertising space leasing and tenant sourcing.
